$comment: Content for the 2026 announcement graphics. Edit this, then run `node graphics/build-announcements.mjs` for PNGs and `.venv/bin/python graphics/build-canva-import.py` for the Canva HTML. Headlines take the punchy part of a talk title; the full title, speakers and slot go in the body. '|' is a line break, and display type shrinks to fit, so a longer name will not break the layout. Every sponsor in `sponsors` gets its own graphic, and `tiers` groups them.
